basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old from Ohio who works as a junior software developer. My love for anime and manga started in high school, and I've been a fan ever since. When I'm not coding or binge-watching anime, I enjoy reading manga, especially when it's too late to watch TV. I'm single and usually spend my evenings online. I love discussing plot theories and character developments in my favorite series. Although I'm not a fan of reality TV, I'm a sucker for romantic comedies and chick flicks. I use Reddit to connect with like-minded fans and occasionally venture into lifestyle discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in the anime world primarily comes from self-teaching through years of watching and reading. I tend to follow fan forums and Reddit threads to stay updated on the latest series and fan theories. My transition into the tech world has been recent, but my analytical skills from coding have also helped me dive deeper into anime plots.
